title: *TODAY* Livestream the Launch of Zeteo UK With Mehdi and Zack Polanski
author: Team Zeteo
content:
It's happening! **Zeteo** is growing like never before with our official
launch in the UK, and we're bringing the party to you. Join our livestream
from London's sold-out Barbican Centre **TODAY** at **2:15pm EDT** (**7:15pm
BST** / **11:15am PDT**).

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

 _Paid subscribers_ will get to watch **Mehdi** take the stage with an A-list
roster of guests, including **Zeteo UK** journalists and contributors **Shehab
Khan, Sangita Myska,** and **Peter Oborne,** as well as Green Party leader
**Zack Polanski**. It's not a celebration unless we have all of our
subscribers who got us to where we are today.

[Share](https://zeteo.com/p/today-livestream-the-launch-of-
zeteo?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&action=share)

Add our livestream to your calendar and watch the launch at
[Zeteo.com](http://zeteo.com/) or [Zeteo.UK](http://zeteo.uk/) by [clicking
here](https://open.substack.com/live-stream/358263?utm_source=post-publish).

If you're a free subscriber, [upgrade to a paid
subscription](https://zeteo.com/subscribe) to access the livestream and watch
the launch live.
